press_references.value: MDO signs agreement with Solidcore to boost mining capabilities

partnership_announcements.description: Minerals Development Oman and Solidcore Resources signed an Employee Exchange Agreement and a non-binding MoU covering technical cooperation, personnel secondments, training, and knowledge exchange in mining.

press_references.value: MDO partners with Solidcore Resources to advance copper exploration project

partnership_announcements.description: Minerals Development Oman signed a strategic partnership agreement with Kazakhstan-based Solidcore Resources to jointly explore and develop a copper project in Block 11B in North Al Batinah, with Solidcore bringing investment and technical expertise.

press_references.value: Oman signs deal for first advanced mining lab

partnership_announcements.description: Minerals Development Oman signed a strategic partnership agreement with ALS Arabia to establish Oman’s first advanced mineral testing laboratory, bringing critical mining analytical services onshore and enabling local high-standard testing capabilities.

press_references.value: MDO grows asset base as Oman bets on mining pipeline

partnership_announcements.description: Minerals Development Oman advanced the Ash-Shuwimiyah Industrial Minerals Project in Dhofar through a newly formed strategic partnership with India’s JSW, focused on developing large gypsum, limestone and dolomite reserves with dedicated port infrastructure.

press_references.value: RO 204m pact boosts South Minerals Project

partnership_announcements.description: Minerals Development Oman signed a partnership with India’s JSW Group (with JSW Infrastructure involved) to develop the RO 204 million South Minerals Project in Shuwaimiyah, Oman, including a 27 Mtpa marine terminal and large-scale gypsum and limestone mining.

press_references.value: Oman: OIA expands footprint with Burkina Faso pacts

partnership_announcements.description: Minerals Development Oman and Burkina Faso’s SOPAMIB signed an agreement to establish a joint venture in the gold mining sector, aiming for high governance, safety, and sustainability standards.
